title: Location metric
description: A generic proximity or access measure from an asset to something that matters. The core defines the shape; the domain defines which targets matter. distance_to_ski_lift is a japan_ski_property instance of this, not a core concept.

metric_key.description: Domain-defined, e.g. nearest_lift, supermarket, convenience_store, station, airport.

target_name.description: The specific target measured to, e.g. the named lift.

requires_vehicle.description: Whether reaching this target realistically requires a car. Materially affects guest experience.

seasonal_variation.description: Where access differs by season, e.g. winter road conditions changing drive time.

measurement_method.description: listing_claim is a seller's assertion and is treated as OPINION until corroborated.
